homeTreatments.treatBlurb: Nasya is an Ayurvedic therapy in which medicated oils, herbal juices, or powders are administered through the nose to cleanse and nourish the head, neck, and respiratory passages.
Abhyanga is a traditional Ayurvedic full-body massage performed using warm herbal oils chosen according to an individual’s body constitution and health condition.
Shirodhara is a calming Ayurvedic therapy in which a continuous stream of warm herbal oil or medicated liquid is gently poured over the forehead, especially the “third eye” area.
